description: Opens the Γ productions that admit Concept->Concept structural-grounding edges (built_from / depends_on / grounds / genls) and the Microtheory->has_concept->Concept frame edge. Without these the read-and-ground faculty comprehends a definition's genus but its built_from mutation is INADMISSIBLE (Type-2: 'Concept' not in the edge vocabulary) and is silently dropped, so the concept never bottoms out at a seeded primitive. The old CuriousAgent opened these at construction (grounded_representation.open_grounding_productions); as a seed they install graph-natively at boot, so any seed-booted agent can ground concepts by reading. Productions, not rules — they widen the admissible-edge schema, they do not rewrite.
